Notes_and_Tips: Avoid pickles as mentioned and keep spice through fresh cooked curries instead.
Since your goal is energy and confidence, keep protein portions strong at lunch.
Choose pan fried or grilled foods instead of deep fried snacks when spicy cravings come.
Simple cooking methods will help you stay consistent daily.
Keep dinner lighter than lunch to support good digestion and steady energy.
